## File: src/parse.ts

```ts
// Parser for the MGPL mail design language (`.mail` files). See docs/language.md for the syntax.
// It collects every problem with its line and column and throws one MailSyntaxError at the end.
import { at, MailSyntaxError, type Diagnostic } from "./errors";
import type { Align, Block, Expr, Inline, MailDocument, Pos, Repeat, Template, Tone } from "./types";

export const FILTERS = ["money", "number", "date", "time", "datetime", "upper", "lower", "default"] as const;
export type FilterName = (typeof FILTERS)[number];

const TONES: Tone[] = ["info", "success", "warning", "danger"];
const FRONT_KEYS = ["subject", "preheader", "footer"] as const;

/** Directives and the attributes each one accepts (`*` = required). */
const DIRECTIVES: Record<string, { attrs: string[]; body: "none" | "blocks" | "lines" }> = {
  button: { attrs: ["href*", "tone"], body: "lines" },
  callout: { attrs: ["tone", "title"], body: "blocks" },
  card: { attrs: [], body: "blocks" },
  rows: { attrs: [], body: "lines" },
  table: { attrs: ["align", "footer"], body: "lines" },
  code: { attrs: [], body: "lines" },
  divider: { attrs: [], body: "none" },
  spacer: { attrs: ["size"], body: "none" },
  image: { attrs: ["src*", "alt*", "width"], body: "none" },
  if: { attrs: [], body: "blocks" },
  each: { attrs: [], body: "blocks" },
};

const IDENT = /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/;

class Parser {
  readonly diags: Diagnostic[] = [];
  private i = 0;
  constructor(private readonly lines: string[], private readonly firstLine: number) {}

  error(pos: Pos, message: string): void {
    this.diags.push(at(pos, message));
  }

  private pos(i: number, col = 1): Pos {
    return { line: this.firstLine + i, col };
  }

  // ---- expressions and templates -------------------------------------------------------------

  /** Parses the inside of `{{ … }}`. */
  expr(src: string, pos: Pos): Expr {
    const parts = splitPipes(src);
    const head = (parts.shift() ?? "").trim();
    const path = head.split(".");
    const out: Expr = { path, filters: [], pos };
    if (!head || !path.every((p) => IDENT.test(p) || /^\d+$/.test(p))) {
      this.error(pos, `Bad variable "${head}": use names like name or patient.name`);
    }
    for (const raw of parts) {
      const m = /^\s*([a-z]+)\s*(?::\s*(.*?))?\s*$/.exec(raw);
      if (!m || !(FILTERS as readonly string[]).includes(m[1]!)) {
        this.error(pos, `Unknown filter "${raw.trim()}" (filters: ${FILTERS.join(", ")})`);
        continue;
      }
      let arg = m[2];
      if (arg !== undefined) {
        const q = /^"(.*)"$|^'(.*)'$/.exec(arg);
        if (q) arg = q[1] ?? q[2];
      }
      if (m[1] === "default" && arg === undefined) this.error(pos, `"default" needs a value: {{ x | default: "…" }}`);
      out.filters.push(arg === undefined ? { name: m[1]! } : { name: m[1]!, arg });
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** Text with `{{ }}` holes (attribute values, front matter, code lines). */
  template(src: string, pos: Pos): Template {
    const out: Template = [];
    let rest = src;
    let col = pos.col;
    for (;;) {
      const open = rest.indexOf("{{");
      if (open < 0) break;
      const close = rest.indexOf("}}", open + 2);
      if (close < 0) {
        this.error({ line: pos.line, col: col + open }, `"{{" is not closed`);
        break;
      }
      if (open > 0) out.push(rest.slice(0, open));
      out.push(this.expr(rest.slice(open + 2, close), { line: pos.line, col: col + open }));
      col += close + 2;
      rest = rest.slice(close + 2);
    }
    if (rest) out.push(rest);
    return out;
  }

  /** Inline markup: **strong**, *em* / _em_, `code`, [label](url), {{ var }}, \ escapes. */
  inline(src: string, pos: Pos): Inline[] {
    const out: Inline[] = [];
    let buf = "";
    const flush = () => {
      if (buf) out.push({ kind: "text", value: buf });
      buf = "";
    };
    let k = 0;
    const p = (off: number): Pos => ({ line: pos.line, col: pos.col + off });
    while (k < src.length) {
      const c = src[k]!;
      const rest = src.slice(k);
      if (c === "\\" && k + 1 < src.length) {
        buf += src[k + 1];
        k += 2;
        continue;
      }
      if (rest.startsWith("{{")) {
        const close = src.indexOf("}}", k + 2);
        if (close < 0) {
          this.error(p(k), `"{{" is not closed`);
          buf += rest;
          break;
        }
        flush();
        out.push({ kind: "var", expr: this.expr(src.slice(k + 2, close), p(k)) });
        k = close + 2;
        continue;
      }
      if (rest.startsWith("**")) {
        const close = src.indexOf("**", k + 2);
        if (close > k + 2) {
          flush();
          out.push({ kind: "strong", children: this.inline(src.slice(k + 2, close), p(k + 2)) });
          k = close + 2;
          continue;
        }
      }
      if ((c === "*" || c === "_") && /\S/.test(src[k + 1] ?? "") && !/[A-Za-z0-9]/.test(src[k - 1] ?? "")) {
        let close = src.indexOf(c, k + 1);
        while (close > 0 && c === "_" && /[A-Za-z0-9]/.test(src[close + 1] ?? "")) close = src.indexOf(c, close + 1);
        if (close > k + 1) {
          flush();
          out.push({ kind: "em", children: this.inline(src.slice(k + 1, close), p(k + 1)) });
          k = close + 1;
          continue;
        }
      }
      if (c === "`") {
        const close = src.indexOf("`", k + 1);
        if (close > k) {
          flush();
          out.push({ kind: "code", value: src.slice(k + 1, close) });
          k = close + 1;
          continue;
        }
      }
      if (c === "[") {
        const mid = findLinkMid(src, k);
        if (mid > 0) {
          const end = src.indexOf(")", mid + 2);
          if (end > 0) {
            flush();
            out.push({
              kind: "link",
              children: this.inline(src.slice(k + 1, mid), p(k + 1)),
              href: this.template(src.slice(mid + 2, end).trim(), p(mid + 2)),
              pos: p(k),
            });
            k = end + 1;
            continue;
          }
        }
      }
      buf += c;
      k++;
    }
    flush();
    return out;
  }

  // ---- blocks ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  /** Parses blocks until a closing `::` (when `closable`), `::else` (when `elseable`) or the end. */
  blocks(opener?: { name: string; pos: Pos; elseable?: boolean }): { blocks: Block[]; end: "close" | "else" | "eof" } {
    const out: Block[] = [];
    while (this.i < this.lines.length) {
      const raw = this.lines[this.i]!;
      const line = raw.trim();
      const indent = raw.length - raw.trimStart().length;
      const pos = this.pos(this.i, indent + 1);
      if (!line || line.startsWith("//")) {
        this.i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (line === "::") {
        this.i++;
        if (opener) return { blocks: out, end: "close" };
        this.error(pos, `"::" closes nothing`);
        continue;
      }
      if (line === "::else") {
        this.i++;
        if (opener?.elseable) return { blocks: out, end: "else" };
        this.error(pos, `"::else" is only allowed inside "::if"`);
        continue;
      }
      if (line.startsWith("::")) {
        const b = this.directive(line, pos);
        if (b) out.push(b);
        continue;
      }
      const h = /^(#{1,3})\s+(.*)$/.exec(line);
      if (h) {
        this.i++;
        out.push({ kind: "heading", level: h[1]!.length as 1 | 2 | 3, content: this.inline(h[2]!, { line: pos.line, col: pos.col + h[1]!.length + 1 }), pos });
        continue;
      }
      if (LIST.test(line)) {
        out.push(this.list(pos));
        continue;
      }
      out.push({ kind: "paragraph", content: this.paragraph(), pos });
    }
    if (opener) this.error(opener.pos, `"::${opener.name}" is not closed (add a line with "::")`);
    return { blocks: out, end: "eof" };
  }

  private paragraph(): Inline[] {
    const out: Inline[] = [];
    let first = true;
    while (this.i < this.lines.length) {
      const raw = this.lines[this.i]!;
      const line = raw.trim();
      if (!line || line.startsWith("//") || line.startsWith("::") || /^#{1,3}\s/.test(line) || LIST.test(line)) break;
      const indent = raw.length - raw.trimStart().length;
      const hard = /(^|[^\\])\\$/.test(line);
      const text = hard ? line.slice(0, -1).trimEnd() : line;
      if (!first) out.push({ kind: "text", value: " " });
      out.push(...this.inline(text, this.pos(this.i, indent + 1)));
      if (hard) out.push({ kind: "br" });
      first = false;
      this.i++;
    }
    while (out.length && out[out.length - 1]!.kind === "br") out.pop();
    return out;
  }

  private list(pos: Pos): Block {
    const ordered = /^\d+\.\s/.test(this.lines[this.i]!.trim());
    const items: Inline[][] = [];
    while (this.i < this.lines.length) {
      const raw = this.lines[this.i]!;
      const line = raw.trim();
      const m = LIST.exec(line);
      const indent = raw.length - raw.trimStart().length;
      if (m) {
        if (/^\d/.test(m[1]!) !== ordered) break;
        items.push(this.inline(m[2]!, this.pos(this.i, indent + m[1]!.length + 2)));
      } else if (line && items.length && !line.startsWith("::") && !line.startsWith("//") && !/^#{1,3}\s/.test(line) && indent > 0) {
        // indented continuation of the previous item
        items[items.length - 1]!.push({ kind: "text", value: " " }, ...this.inline(line, this.pos(this.i, indent + 1)));
      } else break;
      this.i++;
    }
    return { kind: "list", ordered, items, pos };
  }

  /** Raw lines up to the closing `::` (for button, rows, table, code). */
  private rawLines(name: string, pos: Pos): { text: string; pos: Pos }[] {
    const out: { text: string; pos: Pos }[] = [];
    while (this.i < this.lines.length) {
      const raw = this.lines[this.i]!;
      if (raw.trim() === "::") {
        this.i++;
        return out;
      }
      if (raw.trim().startsWith("::")) {
        this.error(this.pos(this.i), `"::${name}" holds plain lines only; close it with "::" first`);
      }
      const indent = raw.length - raw.trimStart().length;
      out.push({ text: raw.trimEnd().slice(indent), pos: this.pos(this.i, indent + 1) });
      this.i++;
    }
    this.error(pos, `"::${name}" is not closed (add a line with "::")`);
    return out;
  }

  private directive(line: string, pos: Pos): Block | null {
    this.i++;
    const m = /^::([a-z]+)\s*(.*)$/.exec(line);
    const name = m?.[1] ?? "";
    const spec = DIRECTIVES[name];
    if (!m || !spec) {
      this.error(pos, `Unknown block "${line.split(/\s/)[0]}" (blocks: ${Object.keys(DIRECTIVES).map((d) => "::" + d).join(", ")})`);
      // skip its body when a closing "::" comes before the next block, so one typo is one error
      let k = this.i;
      while (k < this.lines.length && !this.lines[k]!.trim().startsWith("::")) k++;
      if (this.lines[k]?.trim() === "::") this.i = k + 1;
      return null;
    }
    const restCol = pos.col + line.length - m[2]!.length;
    if (name === "if" || name === "each") return this.control(name, m[2]!, { line: pos.line, col: restCol }, pos);

    const attrs = this.attrs(m[2]!, { line: pos.line, col: restCol });
    const allowed = spec.attrs.map((a) => a.replace("*", ""));
    for (const key of Object.keys(attrs)) {
      if (!allowed.includes(key)) this.error(pos, `"::${name}" has no attribute "${key}"${allowed.length ? ` (allowed: ${allowed.join(", ")})` : ""}`);
    }
    for (const a of spec.attrs) {
      if (a.endsWith("*") && attrs[a.slice(0, -1)] === undefined) this.error(pos, `"::${name}" needs ${a.slice(0, -1)}="…"`);
    }
    const tpl = (key: string): Template => (attrs[key] ? this.template(attrs[key]!.value, attrs[key]!.pos) : []);
    const plain = (key: string): string | undefined => attrs[key]?.value;
    const num = (key: string, def: number, min: number, max: number): number => {
      const v = plain(key);
      if (v === undefined) return def;
      const n = Number(v);
      if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < min || n > max) {
        this.error(attrs[key]!.pos, `${key} must be a whole number from ${min} to ${max}`);
        return def;
      }
      return n;
    };

    switch (name) {
      case "divider":
        return { kind: "divider", pos };
      case "spacer":
        return { kind: "spacer", size: num("size", 24, 4, 96), pos };
      case "image":
        return { kind: "image", src: tpl("src"), alt: tpl("alt"), width: num("width", 536, 16, 600), pos };
      case "callout": {
        const tone = (plain("tone") ?? "info") as Tone;
        if (!TONES.includes(tone)) this.error(pos, `tone must be one of ${TONES.join(", ")}`);
        const { blocks } = this.blocks({ name, pos });
        return attrs.title ? { kind: "callout", tone, title: tpl("title"), children: blocks, pos } : { kind: "callout", tone, children: blocks, pos };
      }
      case "card":
        return { kind: "card", children: this.blocks({ name, pos }).blocks, pos };
      case "button": {
        const tone = plain("tone") ?? "primary";
        if (tone !== "primary" && tone !== "secondary") this.error(pos, `button tone must be primary or secondary`);
        const lines = this.rawLines(name, pos).filter((l) => l.text.trim());
        if (lines.length !== 1) this.error(pos, `"::button" holds exactly one line: its label`);
        const l = lines[0];
        return { kind: "button", href: tpl("href"), tone: tone as "primary" | "secondary", label: l ? this.inline(l.text.trim(), l.pos) : [], pos };
      }
      case "code":
        return { kind: "code", lines: trimBlank(this.rawLines(name, pos)).map((l) => this.template(l.text, l.pos)), pos };
      case "rows": {
        const rows = this.rawLines(name, pos)
          .filter((l) => l.text.trim() && !l.text.trim().startsWith("//"))
          .map((raw) => {
            const { each, line: l } = this.repeat(raw);
            const cells = splitCells(l.text);
            if (cells.length !== 2) this.error(l.pos, `a row is "Label | value"`);
            const row = { label: this.inline(cells[0]?.text ?? "", { line: l.pos.line, col: l.pos.col + (cells[0]?.off ?? 0) }), value: this.inline(cells[1]?.text ?? "", { line: l.pos.line, col: l.pos.col + (cells[1]?.off ?? 0) }) };
            return each ? { ...row, each } : row;
          });
        if (!rows.length) this.error(pos, `"::rows" is empty`);
        return { kind: "rows", rows, pos };
      }
      case "table": {
        const parsed = this.rawLines(name, pos)
          .filter((l) => l.text.trim() && !l.text.trim().startsWith("//"))
          .map((raw) => this.repeat(raw));
        const lines = parsed.map((x) => x.line);
        const rows = lines.map((l) => splitCells(l.text).map((c) => this.inline(c.text, { line: l.pos.line, col: l.pos.col + c.off })));
        const hasFoot0 = attrs.footer !== undefined;
        parsed.forEach((x, k) => {
          if (x.each && (k === 0 || (hasFoot0 && k === parsed.length - 1))) this.error(x.line.pos, "@each is for body rows, not the header or footer");
        });
        const cols = rows[0]?.length ?? 0;
        rows.forEach((r, k) => {
          if (r.length !== cols) this.error(lines[k]!.pos, `this row has ${r.length} cells; the header has ${cols}`);
        });
        let align: Align[] = Array.from({ length: cols }, () => "left");
        const a = plain("align");
        if (a !== undefined) {
          const parts = a.trim().split(/\s+/);
          const map: Record<string, Align> = { l: "left", left: "left", r: "right", right: "right", c: "center", center: "center" };
          if (parts.length !== cols || parts.some((x) => !map[x])) this.error(attrs.align!.pos, `align needs one of l, r, c per column (${cols} columns)`);
          else align = parts.map((x) => map[x]!);
        }
        const hasFoot = attrs.footer !== undefined;
        if (rows.length < (hasFoot ? 3 : 2)) this.error(pos, `"::table" needs a header row and at least one row${hasFoot ? " plus the footer row" : ""}`);
        const head = rows[0] ?? [];
        const body = rows.slice(1, hasFoot ? -1 : undefined).map((cells, k) => {
          const each = parsed[k + 1]!.each;
          return each ? { cells, each } : { cells };
        });
        const foot = hasFoot && rows.length > 1 ? rows[rows.length - 1]! : null;
        return { kind: "table", align, head, body, foot, pos };
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  /** Splits an "@each items as item: …" prefix off a table / rows line. */
  private repeat(l: { text: string; pos: Pos }): { each?: Repeat; line: { text: string; pos: Pos } } {
    const m = /^(\s*@each\s+(\S+)\s+as\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*:\s*)/.exec(l.text);
    if (!m) {
      if (/^\s*@each\b/.test(l.text)) this.error(l.pos, `write "@each items as item: cell | cell"`);
      return { line: l };
    }
    const each: Repeat = { list: this.expr(m[2]!, { line: l.pos.line, col: l.pos.col + m[1]!.indexOf(m[2]!) }), as: m[3]! };
    return { each, line: { text: l.text.slice(m[1]!.length), pos: { line: l.pos.line, col: l.pos.col + m[1]!.length } } };
  }

  private control(name: "if" | "each", rest: string, restPos: Pos, pos: Pos): Block {
    if (name === "if") {
      const m = /^(!?)\s*(.+)$/.exec(rest.trim());
      if (!m) this.error(pos, `"::if" needs a variable: ::if name or ::if !name`);
      const test = this.expr(m?.[2] ?? "", restPos);
      if (test.filters.length) this.error(restPos, `"::if" takes a variable without filters`);
      const first = this.blocks({ name, pos, elseable: true });
      const second = first.end === "else" ? this.blocks({ name, pos }).blocks : [];
      return { kind: "if", negate: m?.[1] === "!", test, then: first.blocks, else: second, pos };
    }
    const m = /^(\S+)\s+as\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)$/.exec(rest.trim());
    if (!m) this.error(pos, `"::each" is written ::each items as item`);
    const list = this.expr(m?.[1] ?? "", restPos);
    if (m && m[2] === "loop") this.error(pos, `"loop" is reserved inside ::each`);
    return { kind: "each", list, as: m?.[2] ?? "item", children: this.blocks({ name, pos }).blocks, pos };
  }

  private attrs(src: string, pos: Pos): Record<string, { value: string; pos: Pos }> {
    const out: Record<string, { value: string; pos: Pos }> = {};
    const re = /\s*([a-z]+)(?:=(?:"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)'|([^\s"']+)))?/y;
    let k = 0;
    while (k < src.length) {
      if (!src.slice(k).trim()) break;
      re.lastIndex = k;
      const m = re.exec(src);
      if (!m) {
        this.error({ line: pos.line, col: pos.col + k }, `Cannot read attributes here: ${src.slice(k).trim()}`);
        break;
      }
      const key = m[1]!;
      const value = m[2] ?? m[3] ?? m[4] ?? "";
      const valueCol = pos.col + m.index + m[0].indexOf("=") + (m[4] !== undefined ? 1 : 2);
      if (out[key]) this.error(pos, `attribute "${key}" is given twice`);
      out[key] = { value, pos: { line: pos.line, col: valueCol } };
      k = re.lastIndex;
    }
    return out;
  }
}

const LIST = /^([-*]|\d+\.)\s+(.*)$/;

function findLinkMid(src: string, open: number): number {
  let depth = 0;
  for (let k = open + 1; k < src.length; k++) {
    if (src[k] === "\\") k++;
    else if (src[k] === "[") depth++;
    else if (src[k] === "]") {
      if (depth === 0) return src[k + 1] === "(" ? k : -1;
      depth--;
    }
  }
  return -1;
}

/** Splits on `|` outside `{{ }}` (filters use `|` too) and outside `\|`. */
function splitPipes(src: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  let cur = "";
  let quote = "";
  for (const c of src) {
    if (quote) {
      if (c === quote) quote = "";
    } else if (c === '"' || c === "'") quote = c;
    else if (c === "|") {
      out.push(cur);
      cur = "";
      continue;
    }
    cur += c;
  }
  out.push(cur);
  return out;
}

function splitCells(line: string): { text: string; off: number }[] {
  const out: { text: string; off: number }[] = [];
  let cur = "";
  let start = 0;
  let depth = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < line.length; k++) {
    const c = line[k]!;
    if (c === "\\" && line[k + 1] === "|") {
      cur += "\\|";
      k++;
      continue;
    }
    if (line.startsWith("{{", k)) depth++;
    if (line.startsWith("}}", k)) depth = Math.max(0, depth - 1);
    if (c === "|" && depth === 0) {
      out.push(cell(cur, start));
      cur = "";
      start = k + 1;
      continue;
    }
    cur += c;
  }
  out.push(cell(cur, start));
  return out;
}

function cell(text: string, start: number): { text: string; off: number } {
  const lead = text.length - text.trimStart().length;
  return { text: text.trim(), off: start + lead };
}

function trimBlank<T extends { text: string }>(lines: T[]): T[] {
  let a = 0;
  let b = lines.length;
  while (a < b && !lines[a]!.text.trim()) a++;
  while (b > a && !lines[b - 1]!.text.trim()) b--;
  return lines.slice(a, b);
}

/**
 * Parses a `.mail` source. Throws a MailSyntaxError listing every problem (line:col message).
 * `file` only labels the messages.
 */
export function parseMail(source: string, file?: string): MailDocument {
  const lines = source.replace(/^﻿/, "").replace(/\r\n?/g, "\n").split("\n");
  const diags: Diagnostic[] = [];
  const front: Partial<Record<(typeof FRONT_KEYS)[number], { value: string; pos: Pos }>> = {};
  let start = 0;
  if (lines[0]?.trim() === "---") {
    let k = 1;
    for (; k < lines.length && lines[k]!.trim() !== "---"; k++) {
      const raw = lines[k]!;
      if (!raw.trim() || raw.trim().startsWith("//")) continue;
      const m = /^\s*([a-z]+)\s*:\s?(.*)$/.exec(raw);
      if (!m || !(FRONT_KEYS as readonly string[]).includes(m[1]!)) {
        diags.push({ line: k + 1, col: 1, message: `Front matter takes ${FRONT_KEYS.join(", ")} ("key: value")` });
        continue;
      }
      front[m[1] as (typeof FRONT_KEYS)[number]] = { value: m[2]!.trim(), pos: { line: k + 1, col: raw.indexOf(":") + 2 } };
    }
    if (k >= lines.length) diags.push({ line: 1, col: 1, message: `Front matter is not closed (add a line with "---")` });
    start = k + 1;
  }
  if (!front.subject?.value) diags.push({ line: 1, col: 1, message: `Every mail needs a subject: start the file with ---, subject: …, ---` });

  const p = new Parser(lines.slice(start), start + 1);
  const tpl = (f?: { value: string; pos: Pos }) => (f && f.value ? p.template(f.value, f.pos) : null);
  const subject = tpl(front.subject) ?? [];
  const preheader = tpl(front.preheader);
  const footer = tpl(front.footer);
  const { blocks } = p.blocks();
  if (!blocks.length && !diags.length && !p.diags.length) diags.push({ line: start + 1, col: 1, message: "The mail has no content" });
  const all = [...diags, ...p.diags].sort((a, b) => a.line - b.line || a.col - b.col);
  if (all.length) throw new MailSyntaxError(all, file);
  return { subject, preheader, footer, body: blocks };
}

/** Problems in a `.mail` source, without throwing (empty when it parses). For editors and CI. */
export function checkMail(source: string): Diagnostic[] {
  try {
    parseMail(source);
    return [];
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof MailSyntaxError) return e.diagnostics;
    throw e;
  }
}
```

## File: src/queue.ts

```ts
// Adapters between the mailer and a BullMQ-style queue/worker. Structural types only: mail-kit
// does not import bullmq; any object with the same methods works.
import type { Mailer, MailJob, MailQueue } from "./mailer";
import type { SendResult } from "./types";

/** The part of a BullMQ `Queue` the mailer uses. */
export interface QueueLike {
  add(name: string, data: MailJob, opts?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<{ id?: string | undefined }>;
}

export interface QueueAdapterOptions {
  /** Job name. Default "mail". */
  name?: string;
  /** Retries with exponential backoff. Default 5 attempts from 10 s. */
  attempts?: number;
  backoffMs?: number;
  /**
   * Whether the queue can take jobs right now. Pass a check of the Redis connection, e.g.
   * `() => connection.status === "ready"`: with ioredis's offline queue, `add` on a dead
   * connection waits instead of failing, so without this check the mail would wait too.
   */
  available?: () => boolean | Promise<boolean>;
}

/**
 * A MailQueue on a BullMQ Queue. Finished jobs are removed at once and failed ones after a day,
 * because a job's data can hold a single-use link (password reset) that should not linger in Redis.
 */
export function queueAdapter(queue: QueueLike, o: QueueAdapterOptions = {}): MailQueue {
  const adapter: MailQueue = {
    async enqueue(job) {
      const added = await queue.add(o.name ?? "mail", job, {
        attempts: o.attempts ?? 5,
        backoff: { type: "exponential", delay: o.backoffMs ?? 10_000 },
        removeOnComplete: true,
        removeOnFail: { age: 24 * 3600 },
      });
      return added.id;
    },
  };
  if (o.available) adapter.available = o.available;
  return adapter;
}

/** The job processor for the worker: `new Worker("mail", mailProcessor(mailer), { connection })`. */
export function mailProcessor(mailer: Mailer): (job: { data: MailJob }) => Promise<SendResult> {
  return (job) => mailer.deliver(job.data);
}
```

## File: src/render.ts

```ts
// Turns a parsed mail + data into email-safe HTML (tables, inline styles) and a plain-text part.
// Every value is escaped; links and images only accept safe URLs; nothing in the source is raw HTML.
import { MailError, MissingVariableError } from "./errors";
import { DEFAULT_BRAND, DEFAULT_THEME } from "./theme";
import type { Block, Brand, Expr, Inline, MailDocument, RenderedMail, Repeat, Template, Theme, Tone } from "./types";

export interface RenderOptions {
  brand?: Brand;
  theme?: Theme;
}

const TZ = "Asia/Kolkata";
const fmtMoney = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", { style: "currency", currency: "INR" });
const fmtNumber = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN");
const fmtDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-IN", { timeZone: TZ, day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric" });
const fmtTime = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-IN", { timeZone: TZ, hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", hour12: true });

// ---- values ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

type Scope = Record<string, unknown>;

class Ctx {
  constructor(
    private readonly scopes: Scope[],
    readonly missing = new Set<string>(),
    private readonly misses = { n: 0 },
  ) {}

  with(scope: Scope): Ctx {
    return new Ctx([scope, ...this.scopes], this.missing, this.misses);
  }

  /** Counts every missing lookup (unlike `missing`, which lists each path once). */
  get missCount(): number {
    return this.misses.n;
  }

  private miss(path: string[]): void {
    this.missing.add(path.join("."));
    this.misses.n++;
  }

  lookup(path: string[]): unknown {
    const [head, ...rest] = path;
    const scope = this.scopes.find((s) => head! in s);
    let v: unknown = scope?.[head!];
    for (const p of rest) {
      if (v === null || v === undefined || typeof v !== "object") return undefined;
      v = (v as Record<string, unknown>)[p];
    }
    return v;
  }

  /** The string for `{{ expr }}`; records it as missing when there is no value and no default. */
  str(e: Expr): string {
    let v = this.lookup(e.path);
    const def = e.filters.find((f) => f.name === "default");
    if (v === undefined || v === null || v === "") {
      if (def) return def.arg ?? "";
      if (v !== "") {
        this.miss(e.path);
        return "";
      }
    }
    let typed = false;
    for (const f of e.filters) {
      switch (f.name) {
        case "money":
          if (typeof v !== "number" || !Number.isInteger(v)) bad(e, "money takes integer paise");
          v = fmtMoney.format((v as number) / 100);
          typed = true;
          break;
        case "number":
          if (typeof v !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(v)) bad(e, "number takes a number");
          v = fmtNumber.format(v as number);
          typed = true;
          break;
        case "date":
        case "time":
        case "datetime":
          v = formatWhen(v, f.name, e);
          typed = true;
          break;
        case "upper":
          v = text(v, e).toUpperCase();
          break;
        case "lower":
          v = text(v, e).toLowerCase();
          break;
      }
    }
    return typed ? String(v) : text(v, e);
  }

  tpl(t: Template): string {
    return t.map((p) => (typeof p === "string" ? p : this.str(p))).join("");
  }

  truthy(e: Expr): boolean {
    const v = this.lookup(e.path);
    return Array.isArray(v) ? v.length > 0 : Boolean(v);
  }

  list(e: Expr): unknown[] {
    const v = this.lookup(e.path);
    if (v === undefined || v === null) {
      this.miss(e.path);
      return [];
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(v)) bad(e, "::each needs a list");
    return v as unknown[];
  }
}

function bad(e: Expr, why: string): never {
  throw new MailError("MAIL_BAD_VALUE", `{{ ${e.path.join(".")} }} at line ${e.pos.line}: ${why}`);
}

function text(v: unknown, e: Expr): string {
  if (typeof v === "string") return v;
  if (typeof v === "number") return Number.isFinite(v) ? String(v) : bad(e, "not a finite number");
  if (typeof v === "boolean" || typeof v === "bigint") return String(v);
  if (v instanceof Date) return formatWhen(v, "datetime", e);
  return bad(e, "objects and lists cannot be printed; pick a field (patient.name) or use ::each");
}

function formatWhen(v: unknown, kind: "date" | "time" | "datetime", e: Expr): string {
  // IST day keys ("2026-10-14") are dates without a time
  if (typeof v === "string" && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v)) {
    if (kind !== "date") bad(e, `${kind} needs a time; "${v}" is a day`);
    v = new Date(`${v}T00:00:00+05:30`);
  }
  const d = v instanceof Date ? v : typeof v === "string" || typeof v === "number" ? new Date(v) : null;
  if (!d || Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) bad(e, `${kind} takes a Date or an ISO date string`);
  const time = () => fmtTime.format(d).replace(/\s?(am|pm)$/i, (_, x: string) => ` ${x.toLowerCase()}`);
  if (kind === "date") return fmtDate.format(d);
  if (kind === "time") return `${time()} IST`;
  return `${fmtDate.format(d)}, ${time()} IST`;
}

/** Repeats `@each` lines once per item, each with its own scope. */
function expand<R extends { each?: Repeat }>(rows: R[], ctx: Ctx): [R, Ctx][] {
  return rows.flatMap((r): [R, Ctx][] => {
    if (!r.each) return [[r, ctx]];
    const items = ctx.list(r.each.list);
    return items.map((item, k): [R, Ctx] => [r, ctx.with({ [r.each!.as]: item, loop: { index: k + 1, first: k === 0, last: k === items.length - 1 } })]);
  });
}

type Flat = { kind: "block"; block: Block; ctx: Ctx } | { kind: "list"; ordered: boolean; items: [Inline[], Ctx][] };

/**
 * Resolves ::if / ::each into the blocks they produce, and joins neighbouring lists, so
 * "::each roles as role / - {{ role.name }} / ::" renders as one list, not one list per item.
 */
function flatten(blocks: Block[], ctx: Ctx, out: Flat[] = []): Flat[] {
  for (const b of blocks) {
    if (b.kind === "if") flatten(ctx.truthy(b.test) !== b.negate ? b.then : b.else, ctx, out);
    else if (b.kind === "each") {
      const items = ctx.list(b.list);
      items.forEach((item, k) => flatten(b.children, ctx.with({ [b.as]: item, loop: { index: k + 1, first: k === 0, last: k === items.length - 1 } }), out));
    } else if (b.kind === "list") {
      const prev = out[out.length - 1];
      const items = b.items.map((i): [Inline[], Ctx] => [i, ctx]);
      if (prev?.kind === "list" && prev.ordered === b.ordered) prev.items.push(...items);
      else out.push({ kind: "list", ordered: b.ordered, items });
    } else out.push({ kind: "block", block: b, ctx });
  }
  return out;
}

// ---- safety ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

const ESC: Record<string, string> = { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" };
export const escapeHtml = (s: string): string => s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ESC[c]!);

/** Evaluates a URL template; skips the safety check when a variable in it is missing (reported later). */
function urlOf(ctx: Ctx, t: Template, kind: "link" | "image", line: number): string {
  const before = ctx.missCount;
  const u = ctx.tpl(t);
  return ctx.missCount > before ? "" : safeUrl(u, kind, line);
}

/** Links may be http(s), mailto or tel. Images must be https. Anything else is refused. */
export function safeUrl(url: string, kind: "link" | "image", line: number): string {
  const u = url.trim();
  const ok = kind === "image" ? /^https:\/\/[^\s]+$/i.test(u) : /^(https?:\/\/[^\s]+|mailto:[^\s]+|tel:[+\d][\d\s-]*)$/i.test(u);
  // eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex
  if (!ok || /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(u)) {
    throw new MailError("MAIL_UNSAFE_URL", `line ${line}: ${kind === "image" ? "image src must be an https URL" : "links must be http(s), mailto or tel"} (got "${u.slice(0, 60)}")`);
  }
  return u;
}

// ---- HTML --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Html {
  constructor(
    private readonly t: Theme,
    private readonly ctx: Ctx,
  ) {}
  private get c() {
    return this.t.colors;
  }

  inline(nodes: Inline[], ctx = this.ctx): string {
    return nodes
      .map((n) => {
        switch (n.kind) {
          case "text":
            return escapeHtml(n.value);
          case "var":
            return escapeHtml(ctx.str(n.expr));
          case "strong":
            return `<strong style="font-weight:700;">${this.inline(n.children, ctx)}</strong>`;
          case "em":
            return `<em style="font-style:italic;">${this.inline(n.children, ctx)}</em>`;
          case "code":
            return `<code style="font-family:${this.t.monoFont};font-size:90%;background-color:${this.c.subtle};padding:1px 4px;border-radius:4px;">${escapeHtml(n.value)}</code>`;
          case "link":
            return `<a href="${escapeHtml(urlOf(ctx, n.href, "link", n.pos.line))}" target="_blank" style="color:${this.c.accent};text-decoration:underline;">${this.inline(n.children, ctx)}</a>`;
          case "br":
            return "<br>";
        }
      })
      .join("");
  }

  blocks(blocks: Block[], ctx = this.ctx): string {
    const { t, c } = this;
    return flatten(blocks, ctx)
      .map((f) => {
        if (f.kind === "block") return this.block(f.block, f.ctx);
        const tag = f.ordered ? "ol" : "ul";
        return `<${tag} style="margin:0 0 16px;padding:0 0 0 22px;font-family:${t.font};font-size:${t.fontSize}px;line-height:1.6;color:${c.ink};">${f.items.map(([i, x]) => `<li style="margin:0 0 6px;">${this.inline(i, x)}</li>`).join("")}</${tag}>`;
      })
      .join("\n");
  }

  private tone(t: Tone): [string, string] {
    return [this.c[t], this.c[`${t}Bg`]];
  }

  private block(b: Block, ctx: Ctx): string {
    const { c, t } = this;
    const fs = t.fontSize;
    const box = (inner: string, gap = 16) =>
      `<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" style="margin:0 0 ${gap}px;"><tr><td>${inner}</td></tr></table>`;
    switch (b.kind) {
      case "heading": {
        const size = [0, Math.round(fs * 1.6), Math.round(fs * 1.27), fs + 1][b.level];
        return `<h${b.level} style="margin:0 0 ${b.level === 1 ? 14 : 10}px;font-family:${t.font};font-size:${size}px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:700;color:${c.brand};">${this.inline(b.content, ctx)}</h${b.level}>`;
      }
      case "paragraph":
        return `<p style="margin:0 0 16px;font-family:${t.font};font-size:${fs}px;line-height:1.6;color:${c.ink};">${this.inline(b.content, ctx)}</p>`;
      case "button": {
        const href = escapeHtml(urlOf(ctx, b.href, "link", b.pos.line));
        const primary = b.tone === "primary";
        const bg = primary ? c.accent : c.surface;
        const fg = primary ? c.accentText : c.brand;
        const border = primary ? c.accent : c.brand;
        return `<table role="presentation" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" style="margin:4px 0 24px;"><tr><td align="center" bgcolor="${bg}" style="border-radius:${t.radius}px;background-color:${bg};"><a href="${href}" target="_blank" style="display:inline-block;padding:12px 28px;font-family:${t.font};font-size:${fs + 1}px;line-height:1.2;font-weight:700;color:${fg};text-decoration:none;border:2px solid ${border};border-radius:${t.radius}px;background-color:${bg};">${this.inline(b.label, ctx)}</a></td></tr></table>`;
      }
      case "callout": {
        const [fg, bg] = this.tone(b.tone);
        const title = b.title ? `<p style="margin:0 0 6px;font-family:${t.font};font-size:${fs}px;line-height:1.4;font-weight:700;color:${fg};">${escapeHtml(ctx.tpl(b.title))}</p>` : "";
        return box(`<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0"><tr><td style="background-color:${bg};border-left:4px solid ${fg};border-radius:${t.radius}px;padding:14px 16px 0;">${title}${this.blocks(b.children, ctx)}</td></tr></table>`);
      }
      case "card":
        return box(`<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0"><tr><td style="background-color:${c.subtle};border:1px solid ${c.line};border-radius:${t.radius}px;padding:20px 20px 4px;">${this.blocks(b.children, ctx)}</td></tr></table>`);
      case "rows":
        return box(
          `<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" style="font-family:${t.font};font-size:${fs}px;line-height:1.4;">${expand(b.rows, ctx)
            .map(
              ([r, x], k) =>
                `<tr><td style="padding:9px 12px 9px 0;color:${c.muted};vertical-align:top;${k ? `border-top:1px solid ${c.line};` : ""}">${this.inline(r.label, x)}</td><td align="right" style="padding:9px 0;color:${c.ink};font-weight:600;text-align:right;vertical-align:top;${k ? `border-top:1px solid ${c.line};` : ""}">${this.inline(r.value, x)}</td></tr>`,
            )
            .join("")}</table>`,
          20,
        );
      case "table": {
        const cell = (tag: "th" | "td", cells: Inline[][], style: string, x = ctx) =>
          cells.map((v, k) => `<${tag} align="${b.align[k]}" style="padding:8px ${k === cells.length - 1 ? 0 : 10}px 8px 0;text-align:${b.align[k]};vertical-align:top;${style}">${this.inline(v, x)}</${tag}>`).join("");
        const head = `<tr>${cell("th", b.head, `font-size:${fs - 3}px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:${c.muted};border-bottom:2px solid ${c.brand};`)}</tr>`;
        const body = expand(b.body, ctx).map(([r, x], k) => `<tr>${cell("td", r.cells, `color:${c.ink};${k ? `border-top:1px solid ${c.line};` : ""}`, x)}</tr>`).join("");
        const foot = b.foot ? `<tr>${cell("td", b.foot, `color:${c.brand};font-weight:700;border-top:2px solid ${c.line};`)}</tr>` : "";
        return box(`<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" style="font-family:${t.font};font-size:${fs}px;line-height:1.4;">${head}${body}${foot}</table>`, 20);
      }
      case "code":
        return box(
          `<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0"><tr><td align="center" style="background-color:${c.subtle};border:1px dashed ${c.line};border-radius:${t.radius}px;padding:16px;font-family:${t.monoFont};font-size:${fs + 7}px;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:3px;font-weight:700;color:${c.brand};text-align:center;">${b.lines.map((l) => escapeHtml(ctx.tpl(l))).join("<br>")}</td></tr></table>`,
          20,
        );
      case "divider":
        return `<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" style="margin:8px 0 24px;"><tr><td style="border-top:1px solid ${c.line};font-size:0;line-height:0;height:1px;">&nbsp;</td></tr></table>`;
      case "spacer":
        return `<div style="height:${b.size}px;line-height:${b.size}px;font-size:1px;">&nbsp;</div>`;
      case "image": {
        const src = escapeHtml(urlOf(ctx, b.src, "image", b.pos.line));
        return box(`<img src="${src}" alt="${escapeHtml(ctx.tpl(b.alt))}" width="${b.width}" style="display:block;width:100%;max-width:${b.width}px;height:auto;border:0;border-radius:${t.radius}px;">`);
      }
      case "list":
      case "if":
      case "each":
        return ""; // resolved by flatten()
    }
  }
}

// ---- plain text --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

const WIDTH = 76;

function wrap(s: string, width = WIDTH, indent = ""): string {
  return s
    .split("\n")
    .map((para) => {
      const words = para.split(/ +/).filter(Boolean);
      const lines: string[] = [];
      let cur = "";
      for (const w of words) {
        if (cur && (indent + cur + " " + w).length > width) {
          lines.push(cur);
          cur = w;
        } else cur = cur ? `${cur} ${w}` : w;
      }
      lines.push(cur);
      return lines.map((l) => indent + l).join("\n");
    })
    .join("\n");
}

class Text {
  constructor(private readonly ctx: Ctx) {}

  inline(nodes: Inline[], ctx = this.ctx): string {
    return nodes
      .map((n) => {
        switch (n.kind) {
          case "text":
          case "code":
            return n.value;
          case "var":
            return ctx.str(n.expr);
          case "strong":
          case "em":
            return this.inline(n.children, ctx);
          case "link": {
            const href = urlOf(ctx, n.href, "link", n.pos.line);
            const label = this.inline(n.children, ctx);
            const bare = href.replace(/^mailto:|^tel:/i, "");
            return label === href || label === bare ? label : `${label} (${bare})`;
          }
          case "br":
            return "\n";
        }
      })
      .join("");
  }

  blocks(blocks: Block[], ctx = this.ctx): string[] {
    return flatten(blocks, ctx)
      .flatMap((f) => {
        if (f.kind === "block") return this.block(f.block, f.ctx);
        return [
          f.items
            .map(([i, x], k) => {
              const mark = f.ordered ? `${k + 1}. ` : "- ";
              return mark + wrap(this.inline(i, x), WIDTH, " ".repeat(mark.length)).trimStart();
            })
            .join("\n"),
        ];
      })
      .filter((s) => s !== "");
  }

  private block(b: Block, ctx: Ctx): string[] {
    const pad = (s: string, n: number, right: boolean) => (right ? s.padStart(n) : s.padEnd(n));
    switch (b.kind) {
      case "heading": {
        const s = this.inline(b.content, ctx);
        if (b.level === 3) return [s];
        return [`${s}\n${(b.level === 1 ? "=" : "-").repeat(Math.min(s.length, WIDTH))}`];
      }
      case "paragraph":
        return [wrap(this.inline(b.content, ctx))];
      case "button":
        return [`${this.inline(b.label, ctx)}:\n${urlOf(ctx, b.href, "link", b.pos.line)}`];
      case "callout": {
        const inner = [...(b.title ? [ctx.tpl(b.title)] : []), ...this.blocks(b.children, ctx)].join("\n\n");
        return [inner.split("\n").map((l) => `| ${l}`.trimEnd()).join("\n")];
      }
      case "card":
        return this.blocks(b.children, ctx);
      case "rows": {
        const rows = expand(b.rows, ctx).map(([r, x]) => [this.inline(r.label, x), this.inline(r.value, x)] as const);
        const w = Math.min(28, Math.max(...rows.map((r) => r[0].length)));
        return [rows.map(([l, v]) => `${(l + ":").padEnd(w + 1)} ${v}`).join("\n")];
      }
      case "table": {
        const all = [
          b.head.map((v) => this.inline(v, ctx)),
          ...expand(b.body, ctx).map(([r, x]) => r.cells.map((v) => this.inline(v, x))),
          ...(b.foot ? [b.foot.map((v) => this.inline(v, ctx))] : []),
        ];
        const widths = b.head.map((_, k) => Math.max(...all.map((r) => r[k]!.length)));
        const line = (r: string[]) => r.map((x, k) => pad(x, widths[k]!, b.align[k] === "right")).join("  ").trimEnd();
        const rule = widths.map((w) => "-".repeat(w)).join("  ");
        const out = [line(all[0]!), rule, ...all.slice(1, b.foot ? -1 : undefined).map(line)];
        if (b.foot) out.push(rule, line(all[all.length - 1]!));
        return [out.join("\n")];
      }
      case "code":
        return [b.lines.map((l) => `    ${ctx.tpl(l)}`.trimEnd()).join("\n")];
      case "divider":
        return ["-".repeat(40)];
      case "spacer":
        return [];
      case "image": {
        urlOf(ctx, b.src, "image", b.pos.line);
        const alt = ctx.tpl(b.alt);
        return alt ? [`[${alt}]`] : [];
      }
      case "list":
      case "if":
      case "each":
        return []; // resolved by flatten()
    }
  }
}

// ---- document ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function firstText(blocks: Block[], ctx: Ctx, t: Text): string {
  for (const b of blocks) {
    if (b.kind === "paragraph") return t.inline(b.content, ctx).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  }
  return "";
}

function brandFooter(brand: Brand): string[] {
  const contact = [brand.phone, brand.email, brand.website].filter(Boolean) as string[];
  return [brand.name, ...(brand.addressLines ?? []), ...(contact.length ? [contact.join("  |  ")] : [])];
}

/**
 * Renders a parsed mail with `data`. Throws MissingVariableError (every missing path at once)
 * when the data lacks a value the mail prints, and MailError MAIL_UNSAFE_URL for unsafe links.
 */
export function renderMail(doc: MailDocument, data: Record<string, unknown>, opts: RenderOptions = {}): RenderedMail {
  const theme = opts.theme ?? DEFAULT_THEME;
  const brand = opts.brand ?? DEFAULT_BRAND;
  const ctx = new Ctx([data]);
  const html = new Html(theme, ctx);
  const text = new Text(ctx);

  const subject = ctx.tpl(doc.subject).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  const bodyHtml = html.blocks(doc.body);
  const bodyText = text.blocks(doc.body);
  const footerNote = doc.footer ? ctx.tpl(doc.footer) : "";
  const preheader = (doc.preheader ? ctx.tpl(doc.preheader) : firstText(doc.body, ctx, text)).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, 140);
  if (ctx.missing.size) throw new MissingVariableError([...ctx.missing]);

  const c = theme.colors;
  const lines = brandFooter(brand);
  const contactLinks = (s: string) => escapeHtml(s);
  const footerHtml = [
    footerNote ? `<p style="margin:0 0 10px;">${escapeHtml(footerNote)}</p>` : "",
    `<p style="margin:0;"><strong style="color:${c.brand};">${escapeHtml(lines[0]!)}</strong>${lines.slice(1).map((l) => `<br>${contactLinks(l)}`).join("")}</p>`,
  ].join("");
  const logo = brand.logoUrl
    ? `<img src="${escapeHtml(safeUrl(brand.logoUrl, "image", 0))}" alt="${escapeHtml(brand.name)}" height="36" style="display:block;height:36px;width:auto;border:0;">`
    : `<span style="font-family:${theme.font};font-size:18px;line-height:1.2;font-weight:700;color:${c.brandText};letter-spacing:.02em;">${escapeHtml(brand.name)}</span>`;
  // Invisible spacers after the preheader keep mail apps from pulling body text into the preview.
  const filler = "&#847;&zwnj;&nbsp;".repeat(60);
  const w = theme.width;
  const r = theme.radius;

  const out = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="x-apple-disable-message-reformatting">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="light">
<meta name="supported-color-schemes" content="light">
<title>${escapeHtml(subject)}</title>
<style>
body{margin:0;padding:0;width:100%;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;-ms-text-size-adjust:100%;}
table{border-collapse:collapse;mso-table-lspace:0;mso-table-rspace:0;}
img{border:0;outline:none;text-decoration:none;-ms-interpolation-mode:bicubic;}
@media (max-width:${w + 20}px){.mk-wrap{width:100%!important;}.mk-pad{padding-left:20px!important;padding-right:20px!important;}}
</style>
</head>
<body style="margin:0;padding:0;background-color:${c.canvas};">
${preheader ? `<div style="display:none;max-height:0;max-width:0;overflow:hidden;mso-hide:all;font-size:1px;line-height:1px;opacity:0;color:${c.canvas};">${escapeHtml(preheader)}${filler}</div>` : ""}
<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" style="background-color:${c.canvas};"><tr><td align="center" style="padding:24px 12px;">
<!--[if mso]><table role="presentation" width="${w}" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0"><tr><td><![endif]-->
<table role="presentation" class="mk-wrap" width="${w}" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" style="width:${w}px;max-width:${w}px;">
<tr><td class="mk-pad" bgcolor="${c.brand}" style="background-color:${c.brand};padding:20px 32px;border-radius:${r}px ${r}px 0 0;">${logo}</td></tr>
<tr><td style="background-color:${c.accent};height:4px;font-size:0;line-height:0;">&nbsp;</td></tr>
<tr><td class="mk-pad" bgcolor="${c.surface}" style="background-color:${c.surface};padding:32px 32px 16px;border-radius:0 0 ${r}px ${r}px;font-family:${theme.font};font-size:${theme.fontSize}px;line-height:1.6;color:${c.ink};">
${bodyHtml}
</td></tr>
<tr><td class="mk-pad" align="center" style="padding:20px 32px 8px;font-family:${theme.font};font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:${c.muted};text-align:center;">${footerHtml}</td></tr>
</table>
<!--[if mso]></td></tr></table><![endif]-->
</td></tr></table>
</body>
</html>
`;
  const textOut = [...bodyText, ["--", ...(footerNote ? [wrap(footerNote), ""] : []), ...lines].join("\n")].join("\n\n") + "\n";
  return { subject, preheader, html: out, text: textOut };
}

/** Every variable path a mail reads (`name`, `patient.name`; loop variables excluded). */
export function mailVariables(doc: MailDocument): string[] {
  const found = new Set<string>();
  const visitExpr = (e: Expr, locals: Set<string>) => {
    if (!locals.has(e.path[0]!)) found.add(e.path.join("."));
  };
  const visitTpl = (t: Template | null | undefined, locals: Set<string>) => t?.forEach((p) => typeof p !== "string" && visitExpr(p, locals));
  const visitInline = (ns: Inline[], locals: Set<string>): void =>
    ns.forEach((n) => {
      if (n.kind === "var") visitExpr(n.expr, locals);
      else if (n.kind === "strong" || n.kind === "em") visitInline(n.children, locals);
      else if (n.kind === "link") {
        visitTpl(n.href, locals);
        visitInline(n.children, locals);
      }
    });
  const visit = (bs: Block[], locals: Set<string>): void =>
    bs.forEach((b) => {
      switch (b.kind) {
        case "heading":
        case "paragraph":
          return visitInline(b.content, locals);
        case "list":
          return b.items.forEach((i) => visitInline(i, locals));
        case "button":
          visitTpl(b.href, locals);
          return visitInline(b.label, locals);
        case "callout":
          visitTpl(b.title, locals);
          return visit(b.children, locals);
        case "card":
          return visit(b.children, locals);
        case "rows":
          return b.rows.forEach((r) => {
            const l = r.each ? (visitExpr(r.each.list, locals), new Set([...locals, r.each.as, "loop"])) : locals;
            visitInline(r.label, l);
            visitInline(r.value, l);
          });
        case "table":
          b.head.forEach((x) => visitInline(x, locals));
          b.foot?.forEach((x) => visitInline(x, locals));
          return b.body.forEach((r) => {
            const l = r.each ? (visitExpr(r.each.list, locals), new Set([...locals, r.each.as, "loop"])) : locals;
            r.cells.forEach((x) => visitInline(x, l));
          });
        case "code":
          return b.lines.forEach((l) => visitTpl(l, locals));
        case "image":
          visitTpl(b.src, locals);
          return visitTpl(b.alt, locals);
        case "if":
          visitExpr(b.test, locals);
          visit(b.then, locals);
          return visit(b.else, locals);
        case "each":
          visitExpr(b.list, locals);
          return visit(b.children, new Set([...locals, b.as, "loop"]));
      }
    });
  visitTpl(doc.subject, new Set());
  visitTpl(doc.preheader, new Set());
  visitTpl(doc.footer, new Set());
  visit(doc.body, new Set());
  return [...found].sort();
}
```

## File: src/smtp.ts

```ts
// A small SMTP client on node:net / node:tls (no dependencies): implicit TLS (465) or STARTTLS (587),
// AUTH PLAIN / LOGIN, one connection per message. Works with Gmail, Zoho, Amazon SES, Brevo, Postfix…
import { connect as netConnect, type Socket } from "node:net";
import { hostname } from "node:os";
import { connect as tlsConnect, type ConnectionOptions, type TLSSocket } from "node:tls";
import { TransportError } from "./errors";
import { buildMessage } from "./mime";
import type { OutgoingMessage, SendResult, Transport } from "./types";

export interface SmtpOptions {
  host: string;
  /** Default 465 when `secure`, else 587. */
  port?: number;
  /** Implicit TLS from the first byte (port 465). Otherwise STARTTLS is used when offered. */
  secure?: boolean;
  user?: string;
  pass?: string;
  /**
   * Refuse to send without TLS. Default true, except for localhost (a local relay or test server).
   * Never turn it off for a remote server: the password and the mail would cross the network in clear.
   */
  requireTLS?: boolean;
  /** Name sent with EHLO. Default: this machine's hostname. */
  name?: string;
  /** Socket inactivity timeout in ms. Default 30 000. */
  timeoutMs?: number;
  /** Extra TLS options (ca, servername, rejectUnauthorized for a private relay…). */
  tls?: ConnectionOptions;
}

/**
 * Options from a URL: `smtps://user:pass@smtp.example.com:465` (implicit TLS) or
 * `smtp://user:pass@smtp.example.com:587` (STARTTLS). User and password are URL-decoded.
 */
export function parseSmtpUrl(url: string): SmtpOptions {
  const u = new URL(url);
  if (u.protocol !== "smtp:" && u.protocol !== "smtps:") throw new TransportError(`SMTP URL must start with smtp:// or smtps:// (got ${u.protocol})`);
  const secure = u.protocol === "smtps:";
  return {
    host: u.hostname,
    port: u.port ? Number(u.port) : secure ? 465 : 587,
    secure,
    ...(u.username ? { user: decodeURIComponent(u.username) } : {}),
    ...(u.password ? { pass: decodeURIComponent(u.password) } : {}),
  };
}

const isLocal = (host: string) => host === "localhost" || host === "127.0.0.1" || host === "::1";

interface Reply {
  code: number;
  lines: string[];
}

/** Line-oriented SMTP conversation over a socket that can be upgraded to TLS. */
class Conversation {
  private buf = "";
  private lines: string[] = [];
  private replies: Reply[] = [];
  private waiting: ((r: Reply | Error) => void) | null = null;
  private failure: Error | null = null;

  constructor(
    public socket: Socket | TLSSocket,
    private readonly timeoutMs: number,
  ) {
    this.attach(socket);
  }

  attach(socket: Socket | TLSSocket): void {
    this.socket = socket;
    socket.setTimeout(this.timeoutMs);
    socket.on("data", (d: Buffer) => this.onData(d.toString("latin1")));
    socket.on("timeout", () => this.fail(new TransportError("SMTP server timed out")));
    socket.on("error", (e) => this.fail(new TransportError(`SMTP connection failed: ${e.message}`)));
    socket.on("close", () => this.fail(new TransportError("SMTP connection closed")));
  }

  detach(): void {
    this.socket.removeAllListeners("data").removeAllListeners("timeout").removeAllListeners("error").removeAllListeners("close");
  }

  private fail(e: Error): void {
    this.failure ??= e;
    const w = this.waiting;
    this.waiting = null;
    w?.(e);
  }

  private onData(d: string): void {
    this.buf += d;
    let nl: number;
    while ((nl = this.buf.indexOf("\n")) >= 0) {
      const line = this.buf.slice(0, nl).replace(/\r$/, "");
      this.buf = this.buf.slice(nl + 1);
      this.lines.push(line);
      if (/^\d{3}(?: |$)/.test(line)) {
        const r: Reply = { code: Number(line.slice(0, 3)), lines: this.lines.map((l) => l.slice(4)) };
        this.lines = [];
        const w = this.waiting;
        this.waiting = null;
        if (w) w(r);
        else this.replies.push(r);
      }
    }
  }

  read(): Promise<Reply> {
    const queued = this.replies.shift();
    if (queued) return Promise.resolve(queued);
    if (this.failure) return Promise.reject(this.failure);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.waiting = (r) => (r instanceof Error ? reject(r) : resolve(r));
    });
  }

  /** Sends one command and checks the reply code. `secret` hides the command in errors. */
  async cmd(line: string, expect: number[], secret = false): Promise<Reply> {
    const reply = this.read();
    this.socket.write(line + "\r\n");
    const r = await reply;
    if (!expect.includes(r.code)) {
      const shown = secret ? "(credentials)" : line.split(" ")[0];
      throw new TransportError(`SMTP ${shown} failed: ${r.code} ${r.lines.join(" ")}`.trim(), r.code);
    }
    return r;
  }
}

/** SMTP transport. One connection per message; `send` resolves once the server accepts the DATA. */
export function smtpTransport(options: SmtpOptions | string): Transport {
  const o = typeof options === "string" ? parseSmtpUrl(options) : options;
  const secure = o.secure ?? false;
  const port = o.port ?? (secure ? 465 : 587);
  const requireTLS = o.requireTLS ?? !isLocal(o.host);
  const timeoutMs = o.timeoutMs ?? 30_000;
  const name = o.name ?? (hostname() || "localhost");

  return {
    async send(message: OutgoingMessage): Promise<SendResult> {
      const built = buildMessage(message);
      if ([built.from, ...built.recipients].some((a) => !/^[\x21-\x7e]+$/.test(a))) {
        throw new TransportError("Non-ASCII email addresses are not supported");
      }
      const socket = await open(o.host, port, secure, { servername: o.host, ...o.tls });
      const conv = new Conversation(socket, timeoutMs);
      try {
        await expectReply(conv, 220);
        let ehlo = await conv.cmd(`EHLO ${name}`, [250]);
        let tls = secure;
        if (!tls && ehlo.lines.some((l) => /^STARTTLS\b/i.test(l))) {
          await conv.cmd("STARTTLS", [220]);
          conv.detach();
          const upgraded = await upgrade(conv.socket as Socket, { servername: o.host, ...o.tls });
          conv.attach(upgraded);
          tls = true;
          ehlo = await conv.cmd(`EHLO ${name}`, [250]);
        }
        if (!tls && requireTLS) throw new TransportError(`${o.host} does not offer TLS; refusing to send in clear (set requireTLS: false only for a local relay)`);
        if (o.user) {
          const auth = ehlo.lines.find((l) => /^AUTH\b/i.test(l)) ?? "";
          if (/\bPLAIN\b/i.test(auth) || !/\bLOGIN\b/i.test(auth)) {
            await conv.cmd(`AUTH PLAIN ${Buffer.from(`\0${o.user}\0${o.pass ?? ""}`).toString("base64")}`, [235], true);
          } else {
            await conv.cmd("AUTH LOGIN", [334]);
            await conv.cmd(Buffer.from(o.user).toString("base64"), [334], true);
            await conv.cmd(Buffer.from(o.pass ?? "").toString("base64"), [235], true);
          }
        }
        await conv.cmd(`MAIL FROM:<${built.from}>`, [250]);
        const accepted: string[] = [];
        let lastRefusal: TransportError | null = null;
        for (const rcpt of built.recipients) {
          try {
            await conv.cmd(`RCPT TO:<${rcpt}>`, [250, 251]);
            accepted.push(rcpt);
          } catch (e) {
            if (!(e instanceof TransportError) || !e.status || e.status < 500) throw e;
            lastRefusal = e;
          }
        }
        if (!accepted.length) throw lastRefusal ?? new TransportError("No recipient was accepted");
        await conv.cmd("DATA", [354]);
        // dot-stuffing (RFC 5321 4.5.2), then the terminating "."
        const body = built.raw.replace(/(^|\r\n)\./g, "$1..");
        await conv.cmd(`${body.endsWith("\r\n") ? body : body + "\r\n"}.`, [250]);
        await conv.cmd("QUIT", [221]).catch(() => undefined);
        return { messageId: built.messageId, accepted };
      } finally {
        conv.detach();
        conv.socket.destroy();
      }
    },
  };
}

async function expectReply(conv: Conversation, code: number): Promise<void> {
  const r = await conv.read();
  if (r.code !== code) throw new TransportError(`SMTP server refused the connection: ${r.code} ${r.lines.join(" ")}`, r.code);
}

function open(host: string, port: number, secure: boolean, tls: ConnectionOptions): Promise<Socket> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const s = secure ? tlsConnect({ host, port, ...tls }) : netConnect({ host, port });
    const ok = () => {
      s.removeListener("error", bad);
      resolve(s);
    };
    const bad = (e: Error) => reject(new TransportError(`Cannot connect to ${host}:${port}: ${e.message}`));
    s.once(secure ? "secureConnect" : "connect", ok);
    s.once("error", bad);
  });
}

function upgrade(socket: Socket, tls: ConnectionOptions): Promise<TLSSocket> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const s = tlsConnect({ socket, ...tls });
    s.once("secureConnect", () => {
      s.removeAllListeners("error");
      resolve(s);
    });
    s.once("error", (e) => reject(new TransportError(`STARTTLS failed: ${e.message}`)));
  });
}
```

import type { Brand, Theme } from "./types";

/**

 */

    accent: "#C2410C",
    accentText: "#FFFFFF",
    ink: "#1D1B18",

  fontSize: 15,

/** Default sender identity. The api passes the lab's own details (report-kit's MGPL_LAB). */
export const DEFAULT_BRAND: Brand = {
  name: "Maa Gayatri Path Lab",
};

type DeepPartial<T> = { [K in keyof T]?: T[K] extends object ? DeepPartial<T[K]> : T[K] };

/** A theme with some tokens replaced: `createTheme({ colors: { accent: "#0B7285" } })`. */
export function createTheme(overrides: DeepPartial<Theme> = {}, base: Theme = DEFAULT_THEME): Theme {
  return { ...base, ...overrides, colors: { ...base.colors, ...overrides.colors } } as Theme;
}

## File: src/transports.ts

```ts
import { mkdir, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { buildMessage } from "./mime";
import type { OutgoingMessage, SendResult, Transport } from "./types";

export interface MemoryTransport extends Transport {
  /** Every message sent so far, newest last. */
  readonly sent: (OutgoingMessage & { messageId: string })[];
  clear(): void;
}

/** Keeps messages in memory. For tests and local development. */
export function memoryTransport(): MemoryTransport {
  const sent: (OutgoingMessage & { messageId: string })[] = [];
  return {
    sent,
    clear: () => void sent.splice(0),
    async send(message) {
      const built = buildMessage(message);
      sent.push({ ...message, messageId: built.messageId });
      return { messageId: built.messageId, accepted: built.recipients };
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Writes each message as an `.eml` file in `dir` (open it in any mail app to see it rendered).
 * For local development only: the files contain whatever the mail contains, reset links included.
 */
export function fileTransport(dir: string): Transport {
  return {
    async send(message): Promise<SendResult> {
      const built = buildMessage(message);
      await mkdir(dir, { recursive: true });
      const name = `${new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-")}-${built.messageId.slice(1, 9)}.eml`;
      await writeFile(join(dir, name), built.raw);
      return { messageId: built.messageId, accepted: built.recipients };
    },
  };
}
```

## File: src/types.ts

```ts
// The mail design language as data: what the parser produces and the renderers consume.

/** Where a node came from in the `.mail` source (1-based). */
export interface Pos {
  line: number;
  col: number;
}

/** `{{ path | filter: arg | filter }}` */
export interface Expr {
  path: string[];
  filters: { name: string; arg?: string }[];
  pos: Pos;
}

/** Text with `{{ }}` holes, used for attribute values and front matter. */
export type Template = (string | Expr)[];

export type Inline =
  | { kind: "text"; value: string }
  | { kind: "var"; expr: Expr }
  | { kind: "strong"; children: Inline[] }
  | { kind: "em"; children: Inline[] }
  | { kind: "code"; value: string }
  | { kind: "link"; href: Template; children: Inline[]; pos: Pos }
  | { kind: "br" };

/** `@each items as item:` in front of a table or rows line repeats that line per item. */
export interface Repeat {
  list: Expr;
  as: string;
}

export type Tone = "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger";
export type Align = "left" | "right" | "center";

export type Block =
  | { kind: "heading"; level: 1 | 2 | 3; content: Inline[]; pos: Pos }
  | { kind: "paragraph"; content: Inline[]; pos: Pos }
  | { kind: "list"; ordered: boolean; items: Inline[][]; pos: Pos }
  | { kind: "button"; href: Template; tone: "primary" | "secondary"; label: Inline[]; pos: Pos }
  | { kind: "callout"; tone: Tone; title?: Template; children: Block[]; pos: Pos }
  | { kind: "card"; children: Block[]; pos: Pos }
  | { kind: "rows"; rows: { label: Inline[]; value: Inline[]; each?: Repeat }[]; pos: Pos }
  | { kind: "table"; align: Align[]; head: Inline[][]; body: { cells: Inline[][]; each?: Repeat }[]; foot: Inline[][] | null; pos: Pos }
  | { kind: "code"; lines: Template[]; pos: Pos }
  | { kind: "divider"; pos: Pos }
  | { kind: "spacer"; size: number; pos: Pos }
  | { kind: "image"; src: Template; alt: Template; width: number; pos: Pos }
  | { kind: "if"; negate: boolean; test: Expr; then: Block[]; else: Block[]; pos: Pos }
  | { kind: "each"; list: Expr; as: string; children: Block[]; pos: Pos };

/** A parsed `.mail` document. */
export interface MailDocument {
  subject: Template;
  preheader: Template | null;
  /** Extra line printed above the brand footer. */
  footer: Template | null;
  body: Block[];
}

/** The lab (or any sender) shown in the header and footer of every mail. */
export interface Brand {
  name: string;
  /** https URL of a PNG/JPG logo. SVG is not shown by most mail apps. */
  logoUrl?: string;
  addressLines?: string[];
  phone?: string;
  email?: string;
  website?: string;
}

/** Design tokens. Every colour and size in a rendered mail comes from here. */
export interface Theme {
  colors: {
    brand: string;
    brandText: string;
    accent: string;
    accentText: string;
    ink: string;
    muted: string;
    line: string;
    canvas: string;
    surface: string;
    subtle: string;
    info: string;
    infoBg: string;
    success: string;
    successBg: string;
    warning: string;
    warningBg: string;
    danger: string;
    dangerBg: string;
  };
  font: string;
  monoFont: string;
  /** Body text size in px; headings scale from it. */
  fontSize: number;
  radius: number;
  /** Content width in px (600 is the safe maximum for mail apps). */
  width: number;
}

/** A rendered mail, ready for a transport. */
export interface RenderedMail {
  subject: string;
  preheader: string;
  html: string;
  text: string;
}

export type Address = string | { name?: string; email: string };

export interface Envelope {
  to: Address | Address[];
  cc?: Address | Address[];
  bcc?: Address | Address[];
  replyTo?: Address;
  /** Overrides the mailer's default sender. */
  from?: Address;
}

/** Everything a transport needs to deliver one message. */
export interface OutgoingMessage extends Envelope {
  from: Address;
  subject: string;
  html: string;
  text: string;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface SendResult {
  messageId: string;
  accepted: string[];
}

/** Delivers a message (SMTP, a provider API, memory for tests…). */
export interface Transport {
  send(message: OutgoingMessage): Promise<SendResult>;
  close?(): Promise<void>;
}
```
